title: Baselines catch a carried finding
result: `horizontal-overflow` (`overflow-excess-px/v1`) and `a11y/*` (`affected-elements/v1`) carry a numeric measurement per screen, kept at the worst through grouping and merging and surfaced as `observed`/`threshold`; the baseline gains an optional validated `measurements` map, and `classifyFindings` takes a policy that fails a known finding risen past its tolerance (1 px, exact count) against the recorded value. Count-only baselines and DB stay unchanged.
evidence: five CLI captures of one build gave identical values; end to end, +43 px exits 1 (`1 new (1 worse than recorded)`), +1 px exits 0; gate-kit 21 and ui-quality 367 tests passed.
